narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Only a number ending in one gives a square ending in one. That means thirty one squared and forty one squared.
<bookmark mark='line'/>Thirty nine ends in nine, and it comes before forty one.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>His jump skips a square that also ends in one.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Check the last digit first, because it decides the last digit of the square.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Seven squared ends in nine. Find the next two squares that end in nine.
